item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","summary":"The prior findings otherwise appear addressed, but the installer’s activation operation is still not atomic.","recommendations":[{"severity":"blocking","location":"Installer & skill dispatch, step 6","issue":"[P1] `ln -sfn` does not atomically replace an existing symlink on Linux or macOS; it normally unlinks the old destination and then creates the new symlink. A crash or concurrent lookup between those operations can leave `current` missing, contradicting the guarantee that the previous release remains active throughout failures.","suggestion":"Create a uniquely named temporary symlink in the same directory, then replace `current` with a single `renameat`/`os.replace` operation after validating both paths are on the same filesystem. Validate `current` with `lstat`, fsync the containing directory for crash durability, and add interruption/concurrent-reader tests proving observers see only the old or new bundle."}]}
